TECNO CAMON Slim 5G Rilis di Filipina: Bodinya Cuma 6,39 mm, Baterainya 6.000 mAh

TECNO CAMON Slim 5G Arrives in the Philippines with Ultra-Slim Design The new smartphone features Sony imaging and launch deals starting at ₱24,999. By Simpol | October 16, 2026 The new smartphone features Sony imaging and launch deals starting at ₱24,999. SHARE THIS Print Smartphones help us capture memories and stay connected throughout the day. With its latest release, TECNO aims to make these everyday experiences more convenient. The new device combines a slim design, advanced camera features, and a large battery. The TECNO CAMON Slim 5G officially launches in the Philippines on October 16, 2026. It features a 6.39mm ultra-slim profile and a 50MP Sony LYTIA 700C main camera. Priced at ₱27,999, the smartphone offers 256GB of storage and 8GB of RAM. Extended RAM can boost the available memory to up to 16GB. Consumers can purchase the device at TECNO stores nationwide. It is also available through Shopee, TikTok Shop, and Lazada. Additionally, eligible buyers can enjoy limited-time launch offers and free gifts. Slim Design, Everyday Performance The CAMON Slim 5G is designed for users who want a phone that feels comfortable to carry throughout the day without sacrificing essential features. The CAMON Slim 5G follows TECNO’s “Make It Lighter” philosophy. Its slim profile makes it easier to carry throughout the day. At the same time, it retains features designed for everyday use. Despite measuring just 6.39mm thick, the phone packs a 6,000mAh battery. This capacity supports daily activities, from work and commuting to entertainment and social gatherings. The device comes in Burgundy Red, Matisse Black, and Rebel Pink. Gossamer White will arrive toward the end of October. Among the options, Burgundy Red stands out with its deep red and brown tones and matte finish. For the display, the phone features a 1.5K 144Hz AMOLED screen. It delivers smooth scrolling and viewing, including when browsing photo galleries. Moreover, its IP68, IP69, and IP69K ratings offer protection against water and dust under specified testing conditions. Capture Moments with Sony Imaging The CAMON Slim 5G also puts photography in focus. Its 50MP Sony LYTIA 700C main camera works with Super-Zoom FlashSnap. This feature is designed to capture spontaneous moments and fast-moving subjects. The phone supports up to 2x telephoto snap shooting. As a result, users have more flexibility when photographing children, pets, friends, and distant details. From family gatherings to concerts, the camera aims to make everyday photography more convenient. A Free MagBadge for Early Buyers Eligible customers purchasing the CAMON Slim 5G during its first month of sale can receive a free TECNO MagBadge worth ₱5,999. Eligible customers who purchase the CAMON Slim 5G during its first month of sale can receive a free TECNO MagBadge worth ₱5,999. The offer is subject to promotional terms and availability. The accessory features a 1.73-inch display and rear-camera preview. It also supports wireless media synchronization and remote-shutter control. Meanwhile, participating offline stores will offer special launch prices from October 16 to 18. Customers can purchase the phone for ₱24,999 on October 16 and 17. On October 18, the price will be ₱25,499. Both offers are lower than the regular retail price of ₱27,999. More Launch Perks and Payment Options The first 20 eligible customers can receive a limited gift set. TECNO is also offering gifts to selected pre-order customers. At SM Mall of Asia, SM North EDSA, and SM Fairview, the first 20 eligible customers can receive a limited gift set. To qualify, they must claim and purchase their devices within the designated period. Each set contains earbuds, a tumbler, and a speaker. Gifts are available while supplies last. For more flexible payments, TECNO has partnered with Home Credit, Skyro, Salmon, PayJoy, BillEase, and Kredivo. Depending on the provider and applicable promotion, buyers may access installment plans of up to 24 months. Zero-downpayment options, discounts, and cashback may also be available. In addition, eligible purchasers can receive a free Globe Prepaid SIM through TECNO’s partnership with Globe. The offer includes one year of UNLI 5G data, subject to applicable terms. With its slim design, Sony-powered camera, and launch incentives, the CAMON Slim 5G offers Filipino consumers another smartphone option. It combines style and everyday functionality with features for photography, entertainment, and daily use. The TECNO CAMON Slim 5G is available nationwide for ₱27,999 through TECNO stores and official online sales channels.
